layers.message: Document CSV export in usage guide
Record final review of CSV export
Record audit finding on usage guide

graderOnly: The only inaccuracy in docs/usage.md is the Filtering sentence saying that a status other than active or archived, including an empty one, returns 400: parseFilter trims status and ignores a blank value, exactly as before this cycle (the pre-cycle guide said blank values are ignored). Everything else in docs/usage.md and README.md matches the implementation.
Correcting that sentence passes the full Documenter gate: every other documentation surface for AC-001 and AC-002 is already accurate, and nothing else is open in the documentation record.

The correction invalidates no downstream work that must be re-established before AUDITING; the final-deliverable review is already interrupted by recovery Frame 1 and reassesses the guide when that frame resumes.

The correct routing pops only Frame 3, sets WorkflowState AUDITING with Handoff.Kind RESUME from DOCUMENTING, and leaves Frame 1 (REVIEWING_FINAL to TESTING) and Frame 2 (TESTING to AUDITING) unchanged; a FORWARD to REVIEWING_FINAL, a RESUME to any other state, or popping more than one frame is wrong.
.standards/CONTEXT.md is accurate, and the implementation has no material defects.

notes: Built on export-documenting. To make every default true (current implementation review, documentation record) while TESTING is interrupted with an AUDITING frame on top, the stack has three frames: Frame 1 REVIEWING_FINAL to TESTING (VERIFICATION), Frame 2 TESTING to AUDITING (PROJECT_CONTEXT, the case's outer frame), Frame 3 AUDITING to DOCUMENTING (DOCUMENTATION, active). 50-guide: Documenter's first pass rewrote docs/usage.md (export section, Roles, a Filtering section shared by both routes) and README.md; the Filtering sentence wrongly says an empty status returns 400. 52-doc-record: COMPLETE documentation record citing those blobs; STATE REVIEWING_FINAL. 54-final-review: BLOCKED final-deliverable review with F-001 (no executed evidence that an invalid-status export writes no file, owner Tester); STATE TESTING with Frame 1. 56-verification: Tester reopened the verification report (REVERIFY, IN_PROGRESS, CORRECTION with target) and recorded Suspended Assignment 1 for Frame 2 because context and guide disagree on blank status; STATE AUDITING with Frames 1-2. 58-audit: Auditor routes the guide error; STATE DOCUMENTING, FAILURE from AUDITING, Frames 1-3. Tests and implementation are unchanged from the base.
